paragraphs: Evreka builds digitized, end-to-end waste management software focused on operational excellence in the waste industry. The company says it works in cooperation with waste management companies, local authorities, and municipalities all over the world.

The platform is split into modules, one of which finds efficient tours for visiting multiple locations and performing duties. Another keeps track of assets as they flow through operations. A commercial product covers operational workflows between service providers and their commercial clients. It is described as a single platform for handling complex business-to-business arrangements across multiple locations and vendors.

Industry pages address specialised streams, including hazardous and liquid waste. The construction and demolition sector is treated as its own category. The company says it reaches millions of people and provides services to waste companies, smart cities and municipalities. Its about page counts more than 10,000 users, three or more global offices, and over 40 countries.

quote.text: Evreka designs digitized and end-to-end waste management solutions with a focus on operational excellence in the waste management industry.
